name: B3 listed companies and indices
description: B3 (Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão), the São Paulo exchange: listed-company registry search and enumeration, company detail with sector classification and financial summary, corporate actions, cash dividend history, CVM filings, index portfolios (IBOV, IBRX, SMLL, IDIV, IFIX...), stock-to-index membership, delayed quotes and the sector taxonomy. Public data, no credentials; Portuguese labels as B3 publishes them.

tools.name: Cash dividends
tools.description: When the `trading_name` (e.g. PETROBRAS) is known from `search_companies` or `company`.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page number.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Rows per page; B3 returns an empty page above 120.

options.name: trading_name
options.about: B3 trading name, e.g. `PETROBRAS`; case-insensitive.

response.about: Paged history of cash distributions (dividends, interest on capital) for a company, keyed by B3 trading name, with approval and ex-dates, amount per share and the closing price before the ex-date.

fields.name: next_page
fields.about: Page to request next; null when this is the last page.

fields.name: total_records
fields.about: Total rows across pages as B3 reports it.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: After `search_companies` returned a `code_cvm`, or when the CVM code is known.

options.name: code_cvm
options.about: CVM registration code, e.g. `9512` (Petrobras). Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

options.name: include_financials
options.about: Also fetch the economic-financial summary (one more request).

response.about: Company detail by CVM code: names, CNPJ, sector classification, activity, website, governance segment, trading codes with ISINs, bookkeepers; optionally the latest financial summary, capital composition, shareholder positions and free float.

fields.name: financials
fields.about: Present only when `include_financials` is true.

fields.name: main_code
fields.about: B3's primary ticker for the company.

fields.name: market
fields.about: Listing market / governance segment label, e.g. `BOVESPA NIVEL 2`.

response.activity: Pesquisa. lavra. refinação. processamento. comércio e transporte de petróleo. de seus derivados. de gás natural e de outros hidrocarbonetos fluidos. além das atividades vinculadas à energia.

tools.name: Company filings
tools.description: For a company's regulatory disclosures; filter by `category` id (1 Assembleia, 2 Reunião da Administração, 3 Aviso aos Acionistas, 4 Fato Relevante, 6 Comunicado ao Mercado, 7 Dados Econômico-Financeiros, 8 Valores Mobiliários Negociados e Detidos, ...).

options.name: category
options.about: B3 filing category id; omit for all categories.

options.name: code_cvm
options.about: CVM registration code, e.g. `9512`. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page number.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Rows per page; B3 returns an empty page above 120.

options.name: year
options.about: Calendar year of delivery; defaults to the current year.

response.about: Paged CVM filings (material facts, notices to the market, minutes, related-party communications, ...) a company delivered in a year, with links to the CVM document viewer and download.

fields.name: next_page
fields.about: Page to request next; null when this is the last page.

fields.name: total_records
fields.about: Total rows across pages as B3 reports it.

tools.name: Corporate actions
tools.description: When the four-letter issuer code (`issuing_company`, e.g. PETR) is known, typically from `search_companies` or `company`.

options.name: issuing_company
options.about: Issuer code, e.g. `PETR`.

response.about: Corporate actions supplement for an issuer: capital stock, share counts, round lot, bookkeepers, and every cash dividend, stock dividend/split and subscription B3 lists.

fields.name: common_shares
fields.about: Number of common shares, parsed; null when the text is not a number.

fields.name: common_shares_text
fields.about: Number of common shares, verbatim as B3 formats it (Brazilian number format).

fields.name: preferred_shares
fields.about: Number of preferred shares, parsed; null when the text is not a number.

fields.name: preferred_shares_text
fields.about: Number of preferred shares, verbatim as B3 formats it (Brazilian number format).

fields.name: round_lot
fields.about: Round lot, parsed; null when the text is not a number.

fields.name: round_lot_text
fields.about: Round lot, verbatim as B3 formats it (Brazilian number format).

fields.name: segment
fields.about: Governance segment code (`NM`, `N2`, `N1`, `BOLSA`...).

fields.name: stock_capital_brl
fields.about: Capital stock in BRL, parsed; null when the text is not a number.

fields.name: stock_capital_brl_text
fields.about: Capital stock in BRL, verbatim as B3 formats it (Brazilian number format).

fields.name: total_shares
fields.about: Total shares, parsed; null when the text is not a number.

fields.name: total_shares_text
fields.about: Total shares, verbatim as B3 formats it (Brazilian number format).

tools.name: Index portfolio
tools.description: To get an index's composition; page through with `page` (default 120 rows covers IBOV in one call).

options.name: index
options.about: Index acronym, e.g. `IBOV`.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page number.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Rows per page; B3 returns an empty page above 120.

options.name: portfolio
options.about: `theoretical`: current four-month portfolio; `day`: today's portfolio by sector with accumulated participation; `preview`: next rebalancing preview.

response.about: Constituents of a B3 index (IBOV, IBRX, SMLL, IDIV, IFIX, ...) with type, theoretical quantity and participation, plus the header totals and reductor: the current theoretical portfolio, the day's portfolio grouped by sector, or the next quarterly preview.

fields.name: next_page
fields.about: Page to request next; null when this is the last page.

fields.name: total_records
fields.about: Total rows across pages as B3 reports it.

tools.name: Industry classification
tools.description: To interpret or filter the `segment` and classification labels returned by the company functions.

options.name: language
options.about: language

response.about: B3's sector taxonomy: sectors, subsectors and segments used to classify listed companies.

tools.name: Quote
tools.description: For a ticker such as PETR4, VALE3, BOVA11. Quotes are delayed per B3 policy.

options.name: symbol
options.about: Ticker, e.g. `PETR4`.

response.about: Delayed quote for one B3 instrument from cotacao.b3.com.br: open, low, high, average, last price, percent change and traded quantity, in BRL.

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.about: B3's message timestamp (São Paulo local time).

tools.name: Search companies
tools.description: First step to find a company's CVM code (`code_cvm`), issuer code and trading name for the detail functions.

options.name: listing_year
options.about: List companies that listed in this year instead of searching; cannot be combined with `query`.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page number.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Rows per page; B3 returns an empty page above 120.

options.name: query
options.about: Company name or ticker prefix (e.g. `petro`, `PETR`). Omit to enumerate the registry.

response.about: Search B3's listed-company registry by name or ticker prefix, enumerate the whole registry page by page, or list the companies that listed in a given year.

fields.name: next_page
fields.about: Page to request next; null when this is the last page.

fields.name: total_records
fields.about: Total rows across pages as B3 reports it.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page number.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Rows per page; B3 returns an empty page above 120.

response.about: Which B3 indices each stock belongs to in the current validity window, searchable by ticker or company prefix.

fields.name: next_page
fields.about: Page to request next; null when this is the last page.
